entries.allowed_claim: The frozen gauntlet implements a standard sine/cosine harmonic basis.
entries.claim_boundary: Standard basis implementation inside a source-authentic frozen gauntlet; no novelty, independent-validation, trading, or endorsement claim follows.
entries.formal_expression: X(t) = [1, sin(2*pi*t/p_k), cos(2*pi*t/p_k)] for each registered period p_k
entries.name: Harmonic design matrix

entries.allowed_claim: The frozen candidate uses ordinary least squares over registered harmonic features and clips negative outputs.
entries.claim_boundary: Standard least-squares implementation with a project-specific nonnegative output contract; the reviewer-grade gate failed and economic action remains disabled.
entries.name: Least-squares harmonic prediction with nonnegative clip

entries.allowed_claim: Frequency discovery ranks registered periods using a transparent nonnegative R-squared diagnostic on the discovery split only.
entries.claim_boundary: This is a development-only ranking diagnostic and not evidence that a physical oscillator, causal frequency, or promoted economic edge exists.
entries.name: Discovery partial R-squared

entries.allowed_claim: The benchmark includes a standard half-life-parameterized EWMA baseline component.
entries.claim_boundary: This is a standard smoothing recursion used inside one frozen protocol; it does not establish an optimal decay constant or economic performance.
entries.name: EWMA half-life recursion

entries.allowed_claim: The frozen inference layer preserves local dependence with a moving-block bootstrap.
entries.claim_boundary: Standard resampling machinery is implemented and tested, but its finite-sample adequacy remains specific to the frozen protocol and data-generating process.
entries.formal_expression: Resample contiguous index blocks of length b with replacement until n indices are produced
entries.name: Moving-block bootstrap sampler

entries.allowed_claim: The gauntlet applies the standard monotone Holm adjustment across the registered test family.
entries.claim_boundary: Standard familywise-error control is correctly implemented, but it does not rescue a failed promotion gate or establish external validation.
entries.formal_expression: p_adj(i) = max_(j<=i) min(1, (m-j+1)*p_(j)) for ordered p-values
entries.name: Holm familywise p-value adjustment

entries.allowed_claim: The EIA benchmark uses a declared robust normalization contract.
entries.claim_boundary: This project-specific scale protects numerical conditioning in a frozen source-authentic benchmark; it is not a calibrated physical uncertainty model.
entries.name: Robust center and scale contract

entries.allowed_claim: The daily EIA lane reports error relative to a seven-day seasonal-naive scale.
entries.claim_boundary: Standard MASE-style scaling is used for one frozen daily-demand lane and does not establish universal seasonality or external acceptance.
entries.formal_expression: MASE_7 = |y-y_hat| / mean_t |y_t-y_(t-7)| with a declared numerical floor
entries.name: Seven-day seasonal MASE scale

entries.allowed_claim: The frozen EIA lane includes a transparent autoregressive ridge baseline.
entries.claim_boundary: This is a standard regularized autoregression baseline and not a proprietary equation, grid-control system, or externally accepted forecast.
entries.formal_expression: beta=(X^T X + lambda*P)^(-1) X^T y with P_00=0; y_hat=x_next^T beta
entries.name: Autoregressive ridge baseline

entries.allowed_claim: Daily holdout rows expose declared error and direction metrics with units.
entries.claim_boundary: These are transparent scoring definitions for source-authentic replay rows; they do not convert forecast error into realized savings, reliability, or causality.
entries.name: Daily forecast metric row

entries.allowed_claim: The paired comparison layer includes an exact two-sided sign test.
entries.claim_boundary: A correct standard test can quantify registered paired signs but does not by itself prove superiority, causality, or independent review.
entries.formal_expression: p=min(1, 2*sum_(k=0)^min(w,n-w) C(n,k)/2^n) after removing zero deltas
entries.name: Exact two-sided sign test

entries.allowed_claim: The prospective hourly protocol uses a declared median weekly-difference normalization scale.
entries.claim_boundary: This scale is part of a frozen prospective implementation; the current projection has no common settled scoring window and supports no performance claim.
entries.name: Hourly weekly-difference target scale

entries.allowed_claim: The sealed-forecast feature contract excludes the target actual and uses declared lags and cyclic bases.
entries.claim_boundary: The tested contract blocks target-actual leakage in this implementation; it is not a universal proof against every leakage mechanism or an accuracy claim.
entries.formal_expression: x_T=[official-minus-lags, lag differences, historical residual moments, cyclic time bases, authority one-hot], excluding actual D_T
entries.name: Leakage-controlled hourly feature vector

entries.allowed_claim: Prospective records are appended to a tamper-evident canonical SHA-256 chain.
entries.claim_boundary: This is a standard local tamper-evident hash chain, not a third-party timestamp, immutable public ledger, or independent custody service.
entries.name: Append-only canonical SHA-256 chain

entries.allowed_claim: The generated benchmark reports normalized Shannon entropy across eight modeled strategies.
entries.claim_boundary: Standard entropy is applied to generated strategy counts only and does not measure semantic correctness, language-model diversity, or DICE attainment.
entries.name: Normalized strategy entropy

symbols.p_i: share of safely completed tasks using strategy i

entries.allowed_claim: A declared weighted objective selects contract margins on generated development conditions.
entries.claim_boundary: The weights are a project-specific generated-benchmark utility definition, not a learned law, operational mission utility, or sponsor-approved objective.
entries.name: Constraint-contract development objective

entries.allowed_claim: A deterministic nonnegative heuristic ranks generated sensor-track assignments in the NV065 software benchmark.
entries.claim_boundary: This is an exploratory generated-resource tasking score and not radar physics, fire-control evidence, SSDS integration, or an operational sensor model.
entries.formal_expression: contribution=(precision*suitability*quality)*covariance_need/(1+0.38*surplus_margin), then bounded policy boosts and release penalties
entries.name: Expected sensor contribution heuristic

entries.allowed_claim: A declared weighted heuristic ranks eligible generated workflow cases.
entries.claim_boundary: The score is an exploratory generated-workflow routing heuristic and does not establish productivity, fairness, causal impact, personnel policy, or DLA readiness.
entries.name: MissionWeave priority score

entries.allowed_claim: The generated workflow benchmark reports a standard Gini dispersion statistic.
entries.claim_boundary: A standard dispersion statistic over generated values is not a fairness audit, disparate-impact analysis, or personnel-policy validation.
entries.formal_expression: G=(2*sum_i i*x_(i))/(n*sum_i x_i)-(n+1)/n for sorted nonnegative x
entries.name: Gini dispersion metric

entries.allowed_claim: A bounded Kuramoto-inspired analogue was evaluated in a generated wave-timing benchmark.
entries.claim_boundary: This is not a governing-equation solver; it does not integrate Kuramoto oscillator dynamics and cannot support physical grid, PLL, RF, or critical-coupling claims.

entries.name: Brachistochrone-labeled descent analogue

entries.allowed_claim: A bounded thermal-plume-inspired cooling proxy passed an internal generated confirmatory benchmark.
entries.claim_boundary: This is not a governing-equation solver; it is not CFD and does not solve Navier-Stokes, heat transfer, facility airflow, or equipment physics.

entries.allowed_claim: The generated branching benchmark includes a standard Dijkstra path baseline over its registered graph costs.
entries.claim_boundary: Dijkstra is standard prior art and the resulting path is optimal only under the benchmark's synthetic graph and cost definition, not a physical network.
entries.formal_expression: dist(v)=min_path sum_e cost(e), updated by alt=dist(u)+cost(u,v) in a priority queue
entries.name: Dijkstra shortest-path search

entries.allowed_claim: An implemented bounded phi-proximity bonus exists as exploratory scoring code.

truth_line: This map distinguishes exact standard methods, operational definitions, heuristic analogues, and exploratory heuristics. It is an internal traceability artifact, not patentability, agency acceptance, independent validation, field validation, or performance certification.
